Christian Patiño Webb has been named the company’s new CEO. | Photo: Olipop 08\.12.2026 By Brooke Just [Google Add as a preferred source on Google](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=foodbusinessnews.net&location=article_header) OAKLAND, CALIF. — Functional soda company Olipop has named Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer to support its next stage of growth. Patiño Webb succeeds Ben Goodwin, founder and CEO, who is transitioning to executive chairman and head of innovation for the company. Goodwin, who founded the company in 2018 to support digestive health, will focus on the company’s long-term vision, advance innovation and also shape its next phase of growth while also stewarding its mission, values and culture and will work in partnership with Patiño Webb. Goodwin will continue to shape the long-term vision of the company by driving breakthrough innovation. “Working in close partnership, Ben will help guide business strategy, ensuring the company continues to build on the vision that created the functional soda category, while Christian brings the leadership expertise needed to expand its impact on consumers,” the statement said.
